subject: [hw] T01 -> R2: tests/emu scripts do carry SPDX (line 2, after shebang); final differential PASS
body: The sweep lists tests/**/*.sh as missing SPDX. All seven gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/*.sh have `# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT` on line 2 (line 1 must be the shebang); the .c/.py files have it on line 1. If your check requires the identifier on the literal first line for scripts, that conflicts with the executable shebang; tell me and I will add a comment convention. Final T01 state: run_diff PASS 19180/19180, run_fuzz PASS, run_tests 5/5; only k_v15_extend is excluded/documented (vectorised CLZ bug reported to V15/R1).
